statement: A private company must have at least one director, and a private company that is not a member of a listed group must have at least one director who is a natural person (Companies Ordinance sections 454(1) and 457(2)); the first directors are the persons named in the registered incorporation form.
caveat: A body corporate may be a director of a private company outside a listed group (section 456 restricts corporate directors only for public companies, guarantee companies, and private companies in listed groups), so the natural-person requirement is a floor beside, not a bar on, corporate directors. Section 458 lets the Registrar direct a company in breach to appoint.
